messages:
Maya: final internal RN draft attached. Targeting tonight 22:00 PT rollout (change window 22:00-00:30). Need an ops liaison and someone to double-check the canary thresholds. cc @Drew @Alice
Drew: I can be ops liaison. Are we pinning model versions for the rollout?
Alice: I'll proof RN microcopy. Suggest calling out fallback to model v1.23.3 if perf regresses — avoids any ambiguity for SRE.
Ben: quick Q on deploy cadence — prefer staggered canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks between. Also, can we add a short maintenance blurb for jobs that hit long tails?
deploy-bot: queued release: release/v1.23.4 -> prod. Plan: canary_1 (10% 15m), canary_2 (50% 15m), full (100%). Runbook: https://intranet/runbooks/release-ops (see steps 1-7).
Carla: Rollback criteria proposed: P95 latency > 350ms OR error rate > 1% sustained for 5m. If triggered, immediate rollback to pinned v1.23.2 and notify #eng-oncall + customer-success.
Maya: thanks — I've added those thresholds and rollback steps to the RN under 'Operational safeguards'. Also added a note for CS about expected behavior during canary.
Drew: oncall handoff: I'll be primary until 23:30 PT, then Shaun takes over. @Shaun can you confirm oncall?
Shaun: confirmed — I'll be monitoring metrics and ready to execute rollback.
Alice: final copy edits done. Suggest internal blast header: "Microlaunch: inference routing improvements — low risk, observability-first rollout." Keep it short for the all-staff digest.
Maya: perfect. I'll publish the internal blurb at 21:30 PT and pin this thread. Please ack when you've seen the pinned message.
Drew: ack.
Ben: ack — will watch for any anomalies in batch job queues during the canary window.
Maya: deploybot, confirm schedule and the manual trigger command we should use.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z. Manual trigger: ```/deploy release/v1.23.4 --confirm```. Canary gating enforced; health checks will auto-stop if thresholds hit.
Maya: thanks everyone — logging this as final. If anything changes, update this thread only.
Drew: noted, will update if we see preflight warnings in staging.
Carla: added a short evacuation step to the runbook in case external infra causes noise. Link in RN updated.
Maya: great — final RN pushed. I'll drop the blast at 21:30 and tag ops + CS.
Shaun: will be standing by.
Maya: closing thread for edits — comments must land before 21:00 PT.
